name: @openlance/aios-openlance-growth-workflows
description: Phase 5 Stage 7 OpenLance Growth Workflows: a deterministic domain subsystem that owns the growth-workflow behavior only (ADR-0055). It composes the six frozen planners (Marketing, Content, SEO, Social, Analytics, Campaign) into reusable OpenLance growth workflows. The Campaign -> Growth Workflows step of the chain: it consumes a Campaign Intelligence output and, through it, the five earlier planner references (all by reference), plus knowledge by reference, and frames a governed workflow task: an immutable GrowthWorkflow carrying the frozen Agent Engine AgentRequest (prompt, provider steps), plus a workflow-quality EvaluationRequest for the frozen Evaluation Engine. It is deterministic and fail-closed; it never executes, schedules, automates, or orchestrates a workflow, never invokes a provider, and builds no new platform infrastructure.
